blockers.summary: Execution-ready validation does not require the Gate M parent model-ledger and capacity-fixture hashes to equal the M0 runtime model hashes.
The worker preserves unbound PYTHONPATH and records but does not bind the actual imported vLLM origin/hash back to the frozen installed-distribution ledger, allowing module shadowing.
Model-ledger verification rebuilds from self-declared model identity without comparing it to the exact M0 Mixtral model ID and revision.

observations: Static Mixtral model, revision, BF16, no-quantization, zero-offload and zero-swap fields are internally consistent.
Three fresh launches and the bounded 28672 plus 4096 token capacity contract are strictly represented.
The M0 claim excludes correctness, quality, throughput, latency, routing, calibration and platform qualification.
claim_boundary: CPU/mock governance and clean-archive reproducibility only; actual model, loaded vLLM, GPU and capacity identities are not established.
authorized_next_stage: CPU-only prospective repair and fresh same-hash review only.
